items.title: File unfair-dismissal claim (Kündigungsschutzklage) at the labour court
items.quote: Möchten Sie die Wirksamkeit der Kündigung gerichtlich überprüfen lassen, müssen Sie spätestens drei Wochen nach ihrem Zugang Klage beim Arbeitsgericht erheben.
items.computation: The letter states it was personally handed to the employee at the workplace on 18.11.2026 ('Dieses Schreiben wurde Ihnen am 18.11.2026 am Arbeitsplatz persönlich ausgehändigt.'), so Zugang (receipt) = 18.11.2026 (a Wednesday). Under § 4 KSchG the Kündigungsschutzklage must be filed within three weeks of Zugang. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of receipt is not counted, so the period starts 19.11.2026. Three weeks later (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB) lands on Wednesday 09.12.2026, which is an ordinary working day (no weekend/holiday shift needed under § 193 BGB). Final day: 09.12.2026.

items.title: Register as job-seeking (arbeitsuchend) with the Agentur für Arbeit
items.quote: Bitte denken Sie daran, sich umgehend bei der Agentur für Arbeit arbeitsuchend zu melden.
items.computation: The letter gives no fixed date, only 'umgehend'. Under § 38 Abs. 1 SGB III, an employee who already knows the end date of the employment relationship must register as arbeitsuchend no later than three months before that end date (otherwise, if informed later than that cutoff, within 3 days of learning it). The employment ends 28.02.2027 (Sunday); three months before that is 28.11.2026 (Saturday). The notice was given on 18.11.2026, i.e. before the three-month cutoff of 28.11.2026, so the ordinary 'three months before end' rule applies rather than the 3-day exception. Since 28.11.2026 falls on a Saturday, the deadline shifts to the next working day, Monday 30.11.2026.

items.title: End of employment relationship
items.quote: Hiermit kündigen wir Ihr seit dem 01.03.2017 bestehendes Arbeitsverhältnis fristgerecht zum 28.02.2027.
items.computation: The letter states the employment is terminated with effect to 28.02.2027, a calendar date printed in the letter; taken as given.

warnings: The three-week deadline to file a Kündigungsschutzklage (09.12.2026) is a strict court deadline fixed by § 4 KSchG — get advice now from a union, an employment lawyer, or the labour court's Rechtsantragstelle rather than relying solely on this calculation.

The 'arbeitsuchend melden' due date (30.11.2026) is derived from § 38 SGB III based on the dates given, not from an explicit deadline printed in the letter, so double-check the current rules with the Agentur für Arbeit.
